Independent exact derivation Leibniz-system nullspace gives dimension 6; imposing ten necessary pointwise local-derivation evaluations yields precisely the displayed seven-parameter upper/lower triangular necessary matrix. Its (e3,e4) block exp offdiagonal is s(e^(3x)−e^x)/(2x). Matching exp(A)[1,1]=−1 forces e^x=−1 and thus this entry zero; impossible for tau≠0. Phi_0 is exp(diag(i*pi,2i*pi,3i*pi,i*pi,2i*pi)), a genuine derivation. Refutes only pi3 Theorem13 surjectivity.
